title: Gamma activity modulates belief updating rather than making experience

statements.text: On the predictive processing reading IWMT uses, gamma-band activity communicates prediction errors and may not itself generate consciousness. It indirectly modulates belief updating at slower frequencies, which reconciles the theory with findings that tie gamma coherence to binding.

sources.quote: gamma-band activity may not itself generate consciousness, but may instead indirectly modulate belief updating at slower frequencies
